summary.text: Elsie Encarnacion represents the 8th District on the New York City Council, which includes East Harlem, Mott Haven, Melrose and parts of the Upper East Side.
Her Council page describes her as a lifelong East Harlem resident and a vice co-chair of the Black, Latino and Asian Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Encarnacion was born at the only public hospital in the district and attended District 4 public schools, and is the daughter of a public school educator, according to her Council page.

It says she has worked for more than a decade in public service and advocacy, including as Chief of Staff to Deputy Speaker Diana Ayala and as Director of Youth Services for Council Speaker Melissa Mark-Viverito.
She is listed as a member of the Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics.
